basis_velocity.clock: the completed raw-turn five-minute bar, using the prior completed five-minute close
basis_velocity.contracts: same-suffix matched-month CL discovery and MCL execution contracts
basis_velocity.zero: MCL and CL move equally; follow
basis_velocity.positive: MCL leads CL; apply the declared lead profile

declared_profiles.primary_lead_breadth: when MCL leads, follow only if at least three raw-turn horizon velocities align with direction; otherwise fade

controls: unchanged v15 raw-turn three-horizon velocity-breadth route
selection_law: primary_lead_breadth is frozen before exact lifecycle outcomes; lead_follow and lead_fade are sensitivity neighbors and cannot replace it from exposed outcomes
prohibitions: no basis, parity, breadth, retention, ATR, stop, target, or timeout threshold sweep
no abstention, daily quota, synthetic re-entry, added delay, or changed hold
